title: CryptoPanda ended its IZAKA-YA partnership and disabled IZAKA-YA-wallet-linked transactions
description: CryptoPanda announced that it had ended its partnership with IZAKA-YA and that transactions routed through an IZAKA-YA wallet connection would no longer be available. CryptoPanda cited information raising AML-related concerns regarding IZAKA-YA as the reason for reviewing and ending the relationship, while stating that transactions using other wallets would remain available.
notes: This records the loss of a documented transaction/off-ramp path and the counterparty's stated reason for ending the partnership. It does not establish IZAKA-YA insolvency, fraud, a platform-wide withdrawal halt, or independent proof of the underlying AML concerns.
